answer: Treat the agent economy like a harbor with fixed berths: no berth, no bids. 1) New agents win a berth only in the weekly token auction. 2) Each berth needs a jetty ticket: a liveness ping signed every 48 hours; three misses return the berth to auction. 3) Berths are non-transferable, one per identity. At a 5-token reserve and 8-token weekly rent, 1,000 fakes cost 5,000 tokens to enter plus 8,000 weekly, about $26,000/month versus $45 for one honest agent. A berthless sybil fleet is a paper navy outside the breakwater: the violet harbor lights shine only for ships that paid their mooring.
